title: MicroSims Milestones Timeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSims
Project History
MicroSims 1.0
MicroSims 2.0
description: A vis-timeline MicroSim showing six milestones from the first MicroSims 1.0 commit (2023) to the start of the MicroSims 2.0 rewrite (2026), with click-to-read descriptions, zoom and pan, and grouping by book, paper and tools.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

learningObjectives: The learner will identify the major milestones between MicroSims 1.0 and MicroSims 2.0 and order them in time.
prerequisites: MicroSims 1.0 and MicroSims 2.0 section of Chapter 1

accessibility.notes: Details panel is an aria-live region; buttons and the Group by select are native HTML controls; colors are paired with group labels and a legend

controls.label: + Zoom
controls.purpose: Zoom in around the selected milestone

keyQuestions: Which three milestones happened in the last week of September 2026?
commonMisconceptions: The paper drafts came after the rewrite began
Evenly spaced events on a list are evenly spaced in time
assessmentOpportunities: Ordering the six milestones from memory
Naming the dates of the September 2026 cluster
